title: Quick Silky Syrian Renkon Lotus Root Bake
description: A citrusy and silky Syrian dish featuring renkon lotus root, perfect for a quick fix, with a Mediterranean twist.

ingredients.name: renkon lotus root
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Add the sliced renkon lotus root to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the lotus root slices in a single layer.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the lotus root is tender and lightly caramelized.
Remove from the oven and brush with pomegranate molasses.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the molasses is bubbly and slightly caramelized.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
